_about: Which picture plays which role. Change a file name here if you rename a picture. Missing pictures are skipped automatically.

story_captions.A1_outside: The solar–PCM cold room on a farm near Visakhapatnam
story_captions.A2_front: Front: door, sensors and the 17° solar canopy facing south
story_captions.A6_door_worker: A farmer brings a crate – every door opening lets warm air in
story_captions.A3_exterior_side_condenser: Side: R290 condensing unit, copper lines and the grid-backup (ATS) box
story_captions.A7_doorway_from_inside: From inside: warm air comes in at the top, cold air spills out at the bottom
story_captions.A8_interior_wide: Inside at 2–8 °C: produce, wax (PCM) panels and the evaporator
story_captions.A9_interior_pcm_wall: Wax (PCM) panels with the copper charging coil – the room's cold battery
story_captions.A10_interior_evaporator: Evaporator: R290 at −5 °C takes the heat out of the room air

mode_captions.A4_night: Night: no sun – the frozen wax (PCM) keeps the room at 2–8 °C
mode_captions.A5_monsoon: Monsoon day: little sun – the wax carries the load, the grid (ATS) is the last backup

doorways._about: Where the door opening is in each picture, in % of the picture (x0..x1 left-right, y0 top, y1 bottom/floor). 'view' = which side the camera is on. Used to draw the warm/cold air flow. Edit by hand to fit a new picture.

pcm_panels._about: Wax (PCM) panels in each picture as rectangles in % (x0,y0,x1,y1). They are tinted blue = frozen, clear = melted, from the live wax battery %.

fans._about: Evaporator fan centre and radius in % of picture width; it glows and pulses with the compressor speed.
